description: This file implements functions for formatting and parsing civil time types (e.g., CivilSecond, CivilMinute, CivilHour, CivilDay, CivilMonth, CivilYear) within the Abseil library, including normalization of year ranges and string conversion utilities.

classes.name: CivilYear
classes.description: Represents a year in civil time.

classes.name: CivilMonth
classes.description: Represents a month in civil time.

classes.name: CivilDay
classes.description: Represents a day in civil time.

classes.name: CivilHour
classes.description: Represents an hour in civil time.

classes.name: CivilMinute
classes.description: Represents a minute in civil time.

classes.name: CivilSecond
classes.description: Represents a second in civil time.

methods.name: FormatCivilTime
methods.description: Formats various civil time types into strings with specific formats.

methods.name: ParseCivilTime
methods.description: Parses strings into civil time types with specific formats.

methods.name: ParseLenientCivilTime
methods.description: Attempts to parse strings into civil time types with lenient matching.
